title: Idle pair exchanges improve the #1094 κ candidate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds a finite candidate on the reviewed #1094 replay. Repartitioning 1,825 disjoint, completely idle rank-48 child pairs as `48 + 48 → 45 + 51` preserves each pair's exact Z4 phase polynomial and improves its exact candidate price from κ = `0.001672660197076918` to κ = `0.001672846574134982` (conservative price `0.001672846571282754`). The paired axis union is unchanged; the maximum child rank is 51 and the finite halving guard remains `73² > 2·51²`.

This is a finite conditional construction and is not promoted to the selected result. The full paid profile is in [`CANDIDATE.json`](research/frontier1094-idle-exchanges/CANDIDATE.json). It retains the 5,120 rank-mass deficit and all existing controller/owner constraints.

## Task and overlap

Base: `dd6403f7` (`main` after the requested pull). Scope: user-assigned search for a better integer multiplication κ using a new idle-pair repartition.

This builds on selected PR #1094 and the T16 rare-pattern exchange source. It follows the idle-child search explored in #1042, but uses rank-48 pair exchanges and includes its own pinned pricing support rather than importing the earlier research helper. Open PR #1183 reports a stronger κ from mixed T37 entrance providers; this submission makes no claim to be the current frontier. Its added value is an independent phase-preserving finite construction, full strict admission receipts, and a replayable overlay on the reviewed #1094 checkpoint.

## Validation

Reproduction commands and exact inputs are in [`research/frontier1094-idle-exchanges/README.md`](research/frontier1094-idle-exchanges/README.md). On Python 3.10 with the repository's pinned engine sources:

- Fresh #1094 hosted emission reproduced the archived template and related baseline artifacts byte-for-byte.
- `build_candidate.py` passed with 1,825 pairs and κ = `0.001672846574134982`.
- `verify_overlay.py` independently passed for all 1,825 pairs and 3,650 changed children.
- The strict independent controller/owner audit passed with all 15 mutation controls rejected.
- Retained strict invoice and assembly receipts pass, including 47 positive outer constraints, 69 assembly mutation controls, and 12 bit-supplier controls.

These are finite certificate checks. The all-size compiler, common-label and mutable-source realization, precision/tape, recovery, analytic transfer, and Lean theorem obligations remain conditional and were not discharged here.

## Credit

The package retains the #1094 replay and T16 source attribution, identifies the earlier #1042 exploration as a predecessor, and discloses OpenAI Codex assistance in its README.

## Open next questions

See the package README: independently reproduce the matching maximum; search broader commuting multi-child moves; and address the inherited end-to-end theorem obligations.
